title: WaterColor 350 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 8 wristbands.- *Newly remodeled bathrooms- 3 Adult Bikes and Helmets- Private backyard- Additional Second-Floor Living Space - Natural Gas Grill - Screened-in Porch with Daybed- 2 Blocks from Camp WaterColor and Tennis Center- Premium Cable Includes HBO, SHOWTIME and Sports Package- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This thoroughly charming 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath cottage in WaterColor's Camp District is the perfect blend of comfort, style and convenience. Tucked away on a wooded lot just 2 blocks from Camp WaterColor and the Tennis Center, 350 Red Cedar Way features stunning design with a screen-in porch, wood ceilings, a chef's kitchen and a second living space on the second floor.Entering through the front door, cherry hardwood floors and overstuffed sofas accent the living space which features a vast flat-screen television - the perfect place for vacation movie night. The kitchen features granite countertops, designer cabinets and select stainless appliances. The dining area offers table seating for 8 before a fireplace, complete with a stone hearth and chimney. The counter has additional seating for 3, while a private breakfast nook offers seating for 4.Located on the first floor the primary bedroom has a king bed, flat-screen television and a private bath with shower only. Ascending the staircase, a second living space features a sectional sofa, flat-screen television and a twin-over-twin bunkbed - the perfect space for the young and the young at heart alike. Adjacent are two guest bedrooms -- both with king beds, flat-screen televisions, and a shared bath with shower only.It's the outdoors spaces that truly set this home apart. The screened-in porches and private backyard allow guests to enjoy the natural setting of WaterColor itself. A daybed on the porch is a great place for a nap. The thoughtful design that incorporates the character of Old Florida with modern amenities makes 350 Red Cedar Way the perfect coastal retreat for up to 8 guests.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR: Guest Bedrooms: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedrooms: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyAdditional Living Space: Twin Over Twin Bunkbed**The fireplace is not for guest use.**Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.
